verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence shows that Workers functions run unmodified Node.js code or arbitrary npm packages. The docs only say Workers supports JavaScript/TypeScript and popular frameworks. A community user explicitly asks for a "full node runtime" and says Workers lacks one (cloudflare-comm-13). Containers (cloudflare-docs-28) can run code for any runtime, but that is a separate product alongside Workers, not the Workers function runtime itself, so it earns no credit here.

support.subject: As a developer, I can run unmodified Node.js code and npm packages in edge/serverless functions instead of a restricted runtime subset
